balance.rationale: The largest frozen S2-80 concatenated-antibody cluster has unique-pair degree 1213 versus an equal-fold target of 906, requiring tolerance >=0.338853. The threshold is not relaxed.

claim_boundary: Provisional train-only S2-80 fold design. No fold is authorized for training or model selection until a separate exact four-view Needleman-Wunsch audit reports zero qualifying cross-fold pairs.

grouping.component_definition: Connected components of the bipartite graph between exact antibody-antigen sequence-pair IDs and PDB IDs.
indivisible: every physical system from one PDB
every physical system sharing one exact antibody-antigen sequence pair
grouping.unassignable: Discard the complete connected component; never split it across retained folds.

objective: maximize retained unique exact antibody-antigen sequence pairs
